tytul: Dried hawthorn and rowan berries: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for drying hawthorn and rowan berries.

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to UW-Madison CIAS, raw rowan berries (European mountain ash, Sorbus aucuparia) contain parasorbic acid, described as a known carcinogen; heat treatment and, to a lesser extent, freezing may neutralize it, and the seeds probably contain hydrogen cyanide.

akapity: The source says only that heat drying may neutralize parasorbic acid; it gives no drying time or temperature for it.
Hawthorn and rowan are not in the drying tables JarAtlas uses, so this card covers both fruits together.
